text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the RFC — we still need a concrete plan for the boarding pipeline's golden input sampling and the sanity handoff to runtime. CI has been noisy for a few models.

arjun: Can you summarize the failure modes you saw? flaky evals, timeouts, or correctness drifts?

maya: Mostly correctness drift on long-tail tokenization edgecases and a few timeouts when the prober hit large sequences. Not hardware timeouts, more infra-level retries that mask flakiness.

sasha: Agree. The inflight problem is we don't have a stable sampling reservoir for golden inputs, so probes randomly miss rare tokens.

lina: Proposed constraints: keep reservoir size bounded (<=500 per model), stratify by tokenizer family + length bucket, and deterministic seeding per model version. :thumbsup:

arjun: Deterministic seed is key. Also we should bind the seed to model-fingerprint + manifest-version so replays are repeatable.

maya: +1. I'm worried about storage/retention if we pin a big reservoir per model. Can we compress golden inputs? maybe store hashes + replay generator rules?

sasha: We can store compressed examples and regeneration hints. E.g. metadata: { "orig_sha":..., "regen_query": "seed:42 len:1024 tokenizer:bpe" }

lina: For the prober, small config example we tested: 
```yaml
golden:
  reservoir: 200
  stratify_by: ["len_bucket","tokenizer_family"]
  seed: 1729
  retain_days: 14
```

arjun: That config looks reasonable. One more: make prober shards stable so CI noise doesn't come from nondeterministic shard assignment.

maya: On shard stability — suggestion: use hash(model_id + manifest_version) % n_shards. That way reruns hit same shard distribution.

sasha: Also we need an adapter contract tweak: adapters should expose a lightweight variant header in error responses (X-variant-id) so bench can correlate failures with model variants. This avoids opaque 500s.

lina: I can add a lint rule in intake that enforces variant-id presence for any model that advertises multi-variant support. Quick lint pseudo: `if model.variants > 1 -> require header`

arjun: Operational: set a CI time budget for the boarding pipeline job (e.g., 30 min). If prober exceeds it, mark as flaky but still allow admit if fallback policy passes. We can't block forever.

maya: Agreed. We should also add a fallback checklist: (1) quick microbench smoke, (2) golden sample check, (3) runtime KV warmup. If any of those fail, gate to manual triage.

sasha: For golden sampling heuristics, propose reservoir refill policy: reservoir = reservoir U new_samples if new_samples stratify to underrepresented buckets; keep rotation by LRU within bucket.

lina: I'll draft a small RFC patch with manifest v2 fields: `golden_reservoir_id`, `golden_seed`, `sampling_rules`, and `prober_shard_hint`.

arjun: One more tech detail — probe commands should be deterministic: `./scripts/probe --shard 3 --seed 1729 --manifest v2` so we can replay locally. Add that to devbox docs.

probe-bot: deploy:prober-run started for model zeta-v3 (shard 3) — logs: https://ci/internal/5467891230/prober

maya: Action items: lina to author manifest v2 patch + lint rule, sasha to write reservoir refill pseudocode, arjun to add shard hashing util, maya to update boarding CI job time budget. We'll sync in a week. :calendar:

arjun: Sounds good. If anyone hits a regression, ping #eng-ml and tag me.

maya: Thanks team — will post the draft RFC patch in this thread when ready.
